How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days. Once shipped, tracking details are sent via confirmation email.
Delivery times depend on the shipping option selected at checkout, such as Standard (3–7 business days) or faster expedited options. Please note that we do not ship on weekends.
If you'd like me to look up your order status, please share your order number and email address!
Order status

long is delivery?

Once shipped, standard delivery generally takes 3–7 business days within the US. Faster expedited options, such as Priority Mail or Express, vary based on the method chosen at checkout.
Please note that made-to-order items (like custom or handmade USA 999 fine silver chains) take 2–3 weeks to craft before they ship out.
If you would like me to look up your specific order details, please share your order number and email address! Is there anything else I can help you with?
